messages:
mira: Quick note from arch checkin—proposal to let a single inference request carry a small precision map so parts of the model (e.g., early layers or attention blocks) can run fp8 while compute-heavy heads run 4-bit. solves multi-task prompts without duplicating model variants.

josh: Interesting. Is this a hint system or are we exposing a hard override?

mira: Both. default is hint (best-effort), but customers can opt into enforced ranges for strict QoS. enforcement will skip cheaper lanes and run guaranteed precision.

anita: Ops concern: how do we avoid nondeterministic fallbacks during a request? we need deterministic decision tree: if hint->soft then record and maybe retry later; if enforced->reject on capacity mismatch or queue in safer lane.

kai: From runtime: keep it simple. API accepts an ordered list of {start_layer,end_layer,precision,mode}. we coalesce ranges server-side and require ranges be contiguous per block to avoid frequent kernel swaps. validator rejects interleaved tiny ranges.

mira: Example payload we discussed: 
```json
{"precision_map":[{"start_layer":0,"end_layer":7,"precision":"fp8","mode":"soft"},{"start_layer":8,"end_layer":-1,"precision":"int4","mode":"soft"}],"request_meta":{"canary":true}}
```
(where end_layer:-1 means to model end).

josh: Good. perf note: switching kernels at layer boundaries can be costly. runtime should merge adjacent same-precision ranges and schedule switches only when necessary. also track switch_count in telemetry.

anita: Telemetry wishlist: applied_map, requested_map, switch_count, fallback_reason, quality_delta_estimate, prompt_id, customer_id, sample_flag. We need a clear schema so SRE can alert on regressions.

\kai: Agree. propose emitting compact fields to our precision stream. sample_flag used for detailed capture (full tokens). default sampling 1% then ramp for canaries.
\dm: (typo note)

mira: UX: SDK exposes client.precisionMap(...) and client.precisionMode = "soft|enforced". devex-bot suggests a high-level helper like client.hintForSpan(span_signature, precision).
\ndevex-bot: Also propose server-side limit: max 12 ranges per request and total covered layers must be monotonic. reject if map size > 12 to bound validation cost.

josh: Testing: unit tests for coalescing logic + perf microbench across 1,2,4 switches. we should also add a shadow-run mode where we execute both hint and baseline and compute degscore offline.

anita: Rollout plan: (1) internal shadow for 2 weeks, (2) opt-in canaries with 3 customers, 3) broader beta with automatic rollback thresholding. define threshold: degscore > 3% drop in quality or 5% user-facing error increase -> rollback.

kai: Implementation steps: front-door parse + canonicalize hints; scheduler attaches plan to worker; worker validates/merges and returns applied_map; worker emits telemetry event with schema_id:v1. I'll open a PR for the parser and a small benchmark harness.

mira: Action items: josh -> RFC follow-up doc with telemetry schema + tests; anita -> canary runbook and rollback criteria; kai -> prototype merge/emit code and perf results; devex-bot -> SDK helper PR. checkin Thurs.

ops-bot: Infra note: canary GPUs queued, set up extra logging stream for precision-telemetry. :rocket:

mira: Thanks everyone. Keep messages short in the RFC thread so it's easier to review. we'll sync on Thurs. :thumbsup:
